title: iPhoneMirror UI 设计稿 v2
status: 待用户确认；尚未列执行计划或实施 Rust 重构
direction: 方案2视觉风格 + 方案3首屏布局

files.prompt:
Create a high fidelity production-quality Chinese Windows desktop application SCREEN, part of ONE coherent iPhoneMirror redesign suite, NOT an alternative concept. Native Rust desktop intended eventually; this is visual design only. Front-on whole app frame 1440 x 1024, not a webpage, not a poster, no surrounding desktop, no perspective, no callouts, no numbered design labels. All screen UI in simplified Chinese. Preserve the selected DARK reference's quiet charcoal surfaces, thin borders, blue primary actions, refined native desktop typography and spacious hierarchy, while simplifying further. Dark tokens #1C1D20 app, #222429 secondary, #F5F5F7 text, #AEB3BD secondary, #60A5FA blue; LIGHT counterparts #F5F6F8 app, #FFFFFF secondary, #18202D text, #626C7A secondary, #0F6CBD blue. No dramatic gradients, unnecessary cards, nested panels, shadows or irrelevant metrics. Fluent-like thin line icon set, 18px body text, 32px headings, 8px spacing grid, 10px control corner radius. Common chrome exactly across suite: 58px header with small blue overlapping-screen app glyph and iPhoneMirror wordmark on left; compact theme dropdown, gear Settings icon and native minimize/maximize/close controls on far right. Native Windows conventions, NOT Mac traffic lights. Body separation through spacing and hairline dividers. All themes have same layout/controls and support follow system/light/dark. One main action per task. Current date is 2026-10-21, omit dates unless necessary. Real product semantics: AirPlay display and optional BLE mouse/keyboard control are independent. Phone settings/pairing are manually confirmed, cannot be toggled remotely. Never claim automatic next-time AirPlay reconnection. Use accurate product name 'iPhoneMirror AirPlay'.
SCREEN: First launch / waiting for AirPlay, DARK mode. Image1 is selected dark art direction; Image2 is desired centered first-launch layout reference. Combine dark visual system from Image1 with simplified centered layout from Image2, not two screens. Entire screen must be DARK, no light panels. Content center aligned with generous margins. No sidebar or wizard steps down the side. Main heading '把 iPhone，带到电脑上。' and secondary '打开屏幕镜像，即可开始。'. Below a discreet small high-quality line illustration of two overlapping display surfaces joined by a thin blue wave, 170px high, keep it understated, no photoreal phone body. Prominent receiver name 'iPhoneMirror AirPlay' with copy icon. Small green dot and text '接收端已就绪 · 等待 iPhone 连接'. Three horizontally arranged instructional steps with thin blue step numbers and short text: '连接同一局域网', '打开「屏幕镜像」', '选择此电脑'; supporting text under each is brief. Single blue button '查看连接指引', adjacent or below link '找不到电脑？'. Lower body one hairline divider and a low-density collapsed optional row with mouse icon '想用电脑操作 iPhone？', subline '连接后，可继续设置蓝牙反控', right '可稍后设置' chevron. Bottom-left subtle text '使用 USB 连接', bottom-right '仅在本机与局域网内传输'. No untrue promise of automatic connection next time. No feature advertising. Theme dropdown displays '暗黑'. Exact same native header appearance as selected art direction but use consistent blue overlapping-screen glyph not the gray icon from old image.

SCREEN: Settings page, DARK theme, same iPhoneMirror native app. Reference is selected visual system not the content to copy. This screen fully replaces workspace until back arrow '返回投屏' is pressed; no stacked modal. Standard identical header. Below header a narrow left navigation column 250px, with '返回投屏' at top, heading '设置', then four simple spaced icon+label nav rows: '外观', '画面与声音', '键鼠控制', '高级与关于'. Active item 外观 uses restrained dark blue soft background and thin blue edge, no giant navigation cards. Bottom of sidebar small plain 'iPhoneMirror'. Right main content in a readable ~840px wide column, large heading '外观', subline '让界面适合你的使用习惯。'. First section heading '主题', subline '可随 Windows 自动切换。'. Show three equal horizontal visual theme preview tiles, not screenshots, small schematic accurate dark/light app layout thumbnails: '跟随系统', '明亮', '暗黑'. Dark selected with thin blue outline and small checkmark. Theme previews show native app chrome, not phone framing. After clear whitespace and one hairline divider, a set of classic aligned settings rows: '界面缩放' with subtext '调整文字与控件大小' and compact dropdown '100%（推荐）' on right; '界面语言' with dropdown '简体中文'; '减少动态效果' with subtext '简化页面切换与提示动画' and toggle off. Another divider. Section '窗口行为' with two aligned rows '关闭主窗口时' dropdown '最小化到托盘'; '启动后记住上次窗口大小' toggle on. Below quiet non-button feedback '更改会自动保存'. No Save/Cancel redundancy, no permissions, no logs or codec names in appearance section. Settings rows mostly on bare page with hairline separation, avoid cards around each row. Balanced content should fit without scrolling or clipping, font generous. Theme dropdown header '暗黑'. Buttons have plausible padding and text.

SCREEN: AirPlay connection interrupted / guided recovery, DARK. This is an actual in-product recovery state of same app, not system error or modal stack. Keep common native titlebar and slim session row '我的 iPhone' and warm amber status '连接已中断', muted 'AirPlay'. Main area split 66% canvas and 34% right recovery rail. Left spacious dark canvas retains position/size of previous portrait source rectangle, but lost connection means no LIVE picture: show very dark desaturated abstract blue/silver last-frame texture with generous centered overlay inside frame, a small disconnected-screen line icon and simple '画面已暂停' label, not physical iPhone hardware. Zero phone bezel, outline, metal rim or notch. Right rail heading '连接断开了', subtext '重新连接后，画面会回到这里。'. One calm amber info line '键鼠控制已释放' to confirm local input safe. A compact helpful two-step instruction, not 6 technical checks: '确认 iPhone 与电脑仍在同一局域网', '在「屏幕镜像」中重新选择 iPhoneMirror AirPlay'. One blue button '查看连接指引'; one secondary text link '返回连接页'. Below divider accordion group heading '遇到了哪种情况？' with three simple rows: '找不到电脑', '能看到，但连不上', '连接后没有画面', all collapsed chevrons. Bottom quiet collapsed '诊断详情' and link '复制诊断信息'. No protocol codes exposed, no dramatic red failure, no untrue button that remotely reconnects phone. Hierarchy favors easy recovery over support details. Theme dropdown 暗黑. All text readable, no cropping, no empty dashboard cards.

designNotes: 画面只显示源内容，不添加 iPhone 机身、边框或摄像头。
AirPlay 与蓝牙反控独立；辅助触控与配对需用户在手机操作。
仅在投屏窗口获得控制焦点时接管键鼠，F9 释放；断线/失焦释放按键。
首屏同一局域网包含电脑通过网线连接；暗黑稿中的同一 Wi-Fi 说明应以此为准。
界面缩放相对 Windows 的 DPI 缩放计算；100% 不意味着禁用系统缩放。
关闭到托盘时应清楚说明是否保持投屏；进入后台时释放键鼠控制。
scope: 5个页面/场景；首次进入、工作区、设置有暗黑和明亮配对稿。设置当前展开外观页，其余分类在导航中示意。
